name: ToolForte API
description: Deterministic utility endpoints for developers and AI agents: IBAN validation, VAT calculation, Dutch holidays and working days, cron parsing, regex testing, JSON/CSV/Base64 transforms, diffs, UUIDs, and Dutch test data. All endpoints accept POST with a JSON body and require a free API key. An MCP server with these tools plus file render tools (PDF, screenshots, QR) is available at https://toolforte.com/mcp.
